derivation: Let g=f'. On 0..2, g=1-x²/4 and integral=4/3. On 2..3 put t=x-2: g=4t³-(11/2)t²-t, integral=1-11/6-1/2=-4/3. Reflection g(x)=g(6-x) gives the two remaining areas -4/3 and 4/3; total 0. At x=2 both pieces equal 0 and slopes equal -1; reflection gives matching value 0 and slope +1 at 4. At 3 the value is -5/2 and both one-sided slopes 0. On 2..3, g'=(t-1)(12t+1)<0; on 0..2, g'=-x/2<0 away from 0; reflection gives increase after 3. Thus f increases, decreases, increases across the intervals, has horizontal local maximum at 2 and minimum at 4, and changes concavity at 3. Integrating gives f=3+x-x³/12 to 2 and f=13/3+t⁴-(11/6)t³-t²/2 to 3; reflection f(x)=6-f(6-x) gives f(3)=3, f(4)=5/3 and f(6)=3. These are unprinted model values, not source givens.
